**Safer keys**
- While a key is shown, the screen can't be screenshotted and is hidden in recent apps.
- A copied key leaves the clipboard after a minute, or right away with "Clear clipboard now".

**Safer imports**
- A backup or settings file that names an AI server you didn't add on this phone says so in the preview, and profiles using it arrive turned off.
- Very large or odd files inside a backup are refused before they can fill your storage.

**If the app closes unexpectedly**
- Next time you open it, Today offers to save a short crash report you can attach to a GitHub issue. It has no meals, notes or keys, and nothing is sent.

**Behind the scenes**
- Every connection uses HTTPS, except your own AI server if you set one up with http.
- Up-to-date libraries and stricter automatic code checks.
